pages.title: Net Control
pages.text: A $(item)net$() is an on-air meeting run by a $(thing)net control station$() (NCS): stations check in, the NCS calls them in turn, messages are passed. The $(item)Net Control$() program (NETLOG) keeps the list for you. F4 sets up a net (name, frequency, mode, your call as NCS) and opens it.

pages.title: Check-ins
pages.text: Ins checks a station in: callsign, name, location or grid square, and two flags: $(thing)traffic$() (a message to pass) and $(thing)short time$() (must leave early). A station already in is rechecked. O checks one out (or back in), T and S set the flags, R counts a recheck, Ctrl+Up/Down moves a station on the list.

pages.title: Roll Call
pages.text: N steps through the roll call: short-time stations first, then those with traffic, then everyone else, in list order. The station called is marked with an arrow.$(br2)F5 prints the net report on the $(l:radiocraft:computer/scanner)scanner$() (paper), F6 saves it as a text file. The net is saved to its .NET file at every change.

pages.title: Closing
pages.text: F8 closes the net and checks everyone out. It offers to put every check-in in the $(l:radiocraft:computer/book_editor)Logbook$()'s LOGBOOK.LOG as a contact, so they count for the $(l:radiocraft:computer/awards)Awards$().$(br2)F9 sets a $(l:radiocraft:computer/scheduler)Scheduler$() reminder for the next net (the Scheduler must be installed).
A blank floppy and a lectern.
